mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.nickname AS nickname, u.is_author AS is_author, 'comment' AS type FROM Comments c JOIN integrated_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Comments (post_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.nickname AS nickname, u.is_author AS is_author, p.title AS post_title, CASE b.board_name WHEN '이 소설 찾아요' THEN 'find' WHEN '신인작가 광장' THEN 'rookie' WHEN '작가 정보관' THEN 'author' END AS board_key, 'comment' AS type FROM Comments c JOIN integrated_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id JOIN Posts p ON c.post_id = p.post_id JOIN Boards b ON p.board_id = b.board_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM Comments WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
